site_name: 3A Goodrich Road And 92A Landcroft Road LondonSouthwarkSE22 9EH
description: Variation of Condition 1 (Approved plans) of planning permission 20/AP/1836 dated 01/09/2020 (Removal of existing hip end roof and creation of an additional storey incorporating three storey extensions to both sides of the existing building and elevational alterations in order to create two 1 bedroom flats.) The amendments sought include:- Changes to height and massing of extensions- Replacement of grey aluminium framed top-floor windows with grey uPVC windows- Replacement of grey aluminium framed glazing to stair cores with grey uPVC framed glazing in a steel frame- Alterations to window glazing pattern- Replacement of glass balustrades to Juliet balconies with grey coated metal railings- Re-location of ground floor entrance to stair core at no. 92A from side to front and lowering entrance to grade- Replacement of ground floor entrance door to side of stair core at no. 92A with window- Removal of glazing bay to side of stair core at no. 92A- Inclusion of glass canopies to ground floor entrances- Additional PV panels to roof and reconfigured arrangement- Removal of green roof- Relocation/addition of water pipes to rear elevation- Alterations to cycle and refuse storage arrangements- Alterations to boundary treatments
